from pathlib import Path

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The non-background shape is the template; palette is the repeated strip.
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[[(grid[r][c] == 1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # Read palette left to right from its repeated horizontal band.
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] not in (0,1) for c in range(w))]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in (0,1) for r in rows)]
    colors=[]
    for c in cols:
        vals=[grid[r][c] for r in rows if grid[r][c] != 0]
        if vals: colors.append(vals[0])
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    sh,sw=len(shape),len(shape[0])
    top=(h-len(colors)*sh)//2
    for i,color in enumerate(colors):
        for dr in range(sh):
            for dc in range(sw):
                if shape[dr][dc]: out[top+i*sh+dr][c0+dc]=color
    return out
'''
